description.value: The Rendezvous Restaurant is a family-owned Greek and Italian restaurant established in 1994 and located in Abbotsford's Old Clayburn Mall. It serves pizza, pasta, and traditional Greek dishes, with house-made dressings and sauces as signature items — including the famous Rendezvous Dressing, available by the bottle to take home. A warm, casual dining room and the ability to host private groups of 20–45 make it a practical stop for cycling groups passing through the Fraser Valley.
